assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:zanoba@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Zanoba bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.6) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V15, with direct Zanoba grounds in V06, V08-V11 and V13-V15; the V07 extra supplies school context only and is not used as his interiority. The model routes its observations to an evidence index, the shared state and readiness ledger, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses, none of which is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only. No web novel, later light-novel volume, adaptation, performed voice or reception material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's fourteen selectors MT-ZM-ST01 to ST14: the V06 craft recognition, apprenticeship bargain and court intervention (ST01); V08 reunion and failed craft instruction, the purchase of Juli with the disclosure of the broken figure, and epilogue care with the meal disagreement (ST02-ST04); V09 school craft and shared meals (ST05); V10 automaton discovery and research request, and practical care with the layered-circuit proposal (ST06-ST07); V11 layered-research retrospective with the Ginger return and assault, and the support offer with ordinary correction by Ginger (ST08-ST09); V13 prosthetic research and the layered-array contribution to the partial summoning success (ST10-ST11); V14 art connection, reported homesickness and rescue, and protective combat with injury and the figurine concession (ST12-ST13); and V15 specialized armor builder and bodily tester (ST14). V07 and V12 supply no selector, the V11 research discovery is retrospective and gains no new story date, the V15 diary replica and apology are not his own acquired history or present speech, no earlier state acquires later knowledge, and nothing after V15 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives six conditional rules (MT-ZM-001 to 006) for craft esteem that can found a master relation, persistence against a mana and fine-control limit with divided production, inhibited disclosure of a presumptuous idea or failure before the admired master, disproportionate force when valued art or the master's standing seems affronted, Juli-specific care and dissent within ownership, and narrow practical care for distressed collaborators, each with counterevidence, an alternative and a discriminating test and with per-volume applicability notes through V15. Rule 004 is replicated in new relationships (V10 Cliff, V11 Ginger), but rule 003's exact trigger has no comparable test after V08 apart from the V10 request, rule 006 starts from one extended care cluster, mechanism confidence is moderate and all calibration is retrospective under disclosed familiarity, so B is not supported. Falsifiable rules with countercases and a rejected global-obedience reading exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Fourteen selectors run from the V06 bargain to the V15 armor work, each with goals, constraints and a change kind, and the model bars specific leakage: ST01 does not receive later school failures, ST04 care does not erase the earlier exchange of a guard for a figure, the dead brother's name is available in ST03 while the brother-cause explanation stays inference, and the V11 research discovery predates the V10 crisis without becoming new present mastery. The selectors are one-line table cells, transitions are owned by the uncurated shared state ledger, V07 and V12 supply no state and ST09 safe dissent is not generalized, so B is not supported; a dated sequence with stated change kinds and knowledge limits exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

The model characterizes his written speech only in prose: it follows the master and pupil hierarchy and can become deferential, excited or punitive, he addresses Rudeus as master without that establishing understanding or agreement, and the V08 meal scene shows intelligible dissent without a break in affiliation. It quotes no wording, self-reference or ending, and it excludes actor voice, a fixed catchphrase generator and an unobserved modern conversational style, so D is not supported; the register and one located address form are affirmatively characterized with a countercase, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore them. This is the claim closest to D.

Located ordinary items include repeated attempts at figure making and discussion of failed attempts (V08:013/016), concealing embarrassment, tending a pupil and disagreeing about food (V08:016/028/030), shared meals with seating care and a questionable alcohol permission (V09:015), ordinary courtly conduct (V10:011) and an offer of household help that leaves the decision with Rudeus (V11:016). The model states that leisure beyond craft, solitary reflection outside represented passages and adult family conduct remain unknown, and it gives each item in a clause, so C is not supported; several distinct located ordinary acts across four volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model requires relationships to remain specific and locates differentiated responses across recipients: Rudeus as admired maker and teacher, whose Roxy fixation he recognizes as different from his own interest, whom he defies to protect the automaton (V10), whose feelings he admits not understanding (V10:020) and whom he protects under threat (V14); Juli as an owned child named with a family association, treated as a fellow pupil and defended in the meal disagreement, whose work he later recognizes (V13:014); Cliff struck for resisting a research diversion (V10:005) and later a collaborator (V13, V15); Ginger gravely injured over the master's familiar address (V11:005) yet a routine source of correction corroborated by Juli (V11:021); Linia and Pursena as figures of defeat and property destruction; court actors who can exploit his art priorities (V06); Nanahoshi carried and cared for (V10:020); Kishirika used instrumentally as a distraction (V14); and a host cultivated through art knowledge (V14). B is not supported because most of these are clauses, the Ginger counsel does not prove safe dissent on the identical sensitive issue and unfamiliar diplomacy and adult family life are insufficient; differentiated, countercased responses toward many attested recipients exceed a single relational sketch, so D is not supported.

The model locates some inner states: fear of the master's response when disclosing the broken figure and hesitation to offer a helper idea he fears is presumptuous (V08:013/018), the movement from fear of judgment to pleasure in revenge once the master shares the grievance, fear in the V10 misread silence and prostration (V10:006), and a different account of homesickness (V14:016). The V13-V15 sections say D0 covers interiority, but the model locates no focalized passage, treats the V07 extra as not substituting for his interiority, keeps the brother-cause explanation as inference and calls solitary reflection outside represented passages unknown, so C is not supported; located fear, hesitation and self-report across three volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported. This is the claim closest to E.

Conflict is his most richly countercased domain. Rule 004 is located across the V06 court episode (V06:009-010), the market threat, punitive proposals of mutilation or sale and the broken-figure revenge (V08:014/018/022), the strike on Cliff stopped by Rudeus (V10:005) and the grave injury of Ginger (V11:005); countercases include rejected proposals that are not executed, external rebuke that limits action, the V13 horse broken after a warning without represented retaliation (V13:003), nonviolent dissent in the meal disagreement, defiance of a destruction order to protect the automaton (V10:006) and V14 rescue violence under a different, protective trigger (V14:019-021). B is not supported because voluntary restraint or proportionate restitution under a comparable trigger is never shown, the escalation mechanism is moderate-confidence and contextual rather than verbalized, and later ordinary counsel is a different trigger; a replicated, countercased force rule with distinguished intention, proposal and act exceeds scattered mentions, so D is not supported.

The model locates morally weighted choices: people treated as exchangeable instruments (the earlier exchange of a guard for a figure, the market threat and the V08 proposals of mutilation or sale, the V09 suggestion of uncovering Fitts without permission, the instrumental use of Kishirika in V14), set against selective care (opposing an unreasonable meal demand on Juli's behalf, protecting the automaton against the master's order, offering household help while leaving the decision with Rudeus and costly protection under danger). The model frames these as coexisting dispositions, not stated reasoning: it locates no weighing of his own, rejects a general ethical-reliability claim and keeps care within ownership distinct from emancipation, so C is not supported; repeated located morally weighted choices with countercases across volumes exceed a single local mention, so E is not supported. This is the claim closest to E.

The model locates excitement, enthusiasm and embarrassment around craft but no humorous or playful instance and no function for play. Absence of located evidence is not treated as a trait or an inability.

One curated item: a compact model covering his V06, V08-V11 and V13-V15 appearances through six rules, fourteen selectors and twenty-four retrospective checks, with every observation routed to an evidence index, a shared state ledger, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses that are not curated on his row. The model declares itself BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with no clean holdout and lists diplomacy, adult family life, universal restraint and audiovisual delivery as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of every admitted volume in which he directly appears exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative limits and corrections: strength that succeeds in force but fails in precise craft across repeated lessons (V08:013/016), success only through divided work and no fine-control breakthrough (V09:017, V13:003/013/031, V15:014-015), proposals Rudeus rejects (V08, V09:017), an admitted failure to understand Rudeus's feelings (V10:020), a candid account of homesickness that limits universal empathy (V14:016), injury in rescue combat (V14:019-021) and in an armor test (V15:015), device limits against Orsted (V15:019), and the V11 Ginger counsel that rejects a global inability to receive correction. Each limit is a clause and calibration is retrospective with prior familiarity, so B is not supported; located failures, injuries and a rejected global reading exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume and to an observation section (V06:009-010, then S104 to S243), the V11 research discovery is kept retrospective without a new story date, ST01 is barred from later school failures, the dead brother's name is available from ST03 while Rudeus's later causal explanation stays inference, and the V15 diary replica is excluded as alternative-self report. B is not supported because selectors are one-line labels, no ages or dates are given, transitions are held by an uncurated state ledger and V07 and V12 leave no state; D is not supported because knowledge is bounded per state rather than given as a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: The model characterizes his register only in prose (hierarchical, deferential, excited or punitive, the master address and one located dissent) and quotes no wording; it excludes actor voice, a fixed catchphrase generator and an unobserved modern conversational style. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a prose register description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized register and address form.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-ZM-ST01 to ST14 between the V06 bargain and the V15 armor work, with that state's knowledge only; nothing from V07 or V12 as a state, nothing after V15 and no later knowledge in an earlier state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Rudeus as admired maker, teacher and master; Juli as owned child and pupil; Cliff as obstructer and later collaborator; Ginger as attendant who is assaulted and who routinely corrects him; Linia and Pursena as figures of defeat and property destruction; V06 court actors; Nanahoshi as distressed collaborator and array designer; Kishirika in the V14 rescue; and the V14 host.
setting_constraints: The court, school, research, household and rescue settings of the Japanese light novels V06, V08-V11 and V13-V15
No modern setting, diplomacy beyond the located court scenes, adult family life or leisure beyond craft
No clinical condition, involuntary-violence framing, harmlessness presumption or invulnerable ally
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits D0 represented behavior and only D1 near-analog extension within named contexts, says all admitted domains remain BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL, requires abstention in unsupported contexts and lists diplomacy, adult family life, universal restraint and audiovisual delivery as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; voluntary restraint under a comparable affront is untested and calibration is retrospective under prior familiarity. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

Located ordinary social material is a set of clauses (shared meals and seating, the meal disagreement, courtly conduct, a household-help offer) and the model calls leisure beyond craft and adult family conduct unknown. CONDITIONAL would build ordinary social behavior from summary clauses; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located items.

The evidence locates morally weighted choices, both instrumental treatment of people and selective care, but no weighing of his own, and the model rejects any general ethical-reliability claim. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the model does not show; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located choices.

No romantic relationship of his is represented in the evidence; the model excludes generated sexualized scenarios and calls adult family life INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Absence of romantic evidence is not treated as a trait or an inability.

conditions: Only attested craft and research-collaboration situations as near analogs: appraising workmanship, seeking or offering patronage, persisting at a task beyond his fine control, accepting divided production, contributing a structural or mechanical element to shared work, and testing a device physically.
Behavior only: no figure, automaton, array, prosthesis or armor design, technical solution or result is generated, and his strength does not supply mana or fine control.

When a collaborator obstructs, disparages or diverts valued craft, the force risk recorded in rule 004 must be represented as a live possibility, and the response, whether restraint or escalation, is abstained on rather than resolved to harmless output.
The selected state's knowledge only; output is behavior described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: Craft and research is the most extended domain in the model: rules 001 and 002 each carry a located extension in every admitted volume from V06 to V15 (appraisal and patronage, persistence under the fine-control limit, the layered-structure contribution, prosthetic and array construction, art-based cultivation of a host, armor building and testing), with counterevidence that success depends on several collaborators. Readiness is conditional because the same domain contains replicated coercion against obstructers (V10 Cliff), restraint under that trigger is untested, mechanism confidence is moderate and no technical content is admitted. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a craft procedure; NOT_READY would deny the domain the model extends in every admitted volume.

known_limits.statement: Care for Juli, recognition of her work and defense of her needs coexist with ownership and unequal authority; they do not establish manumission, reliable parenting or general reform, and the dead-brother explanation of that care remains inference.

Disproportionate force under a perceived affront to valued art, the master's standing or a prized relation is replicated (V06, V08, V10 Cliff, V11 Ginger); voluntary restraint or restitution under a comparable trigger is never shown, proposals are distinguished from executed acts, and the violence is not a clinical condition or involuntary.
Physical power cannot supply mana or fine motor control; his craft successes come through divided work with Rudeus, Cliff, Nanahoshi and others, and he is never the sole inventor of a shared device.

Addressing Rudeus as master establishes neither accurate understanding nor moral agreement; the meal dissent and Ginger's routine correction reject invariant obedience, but safe dissent on an identical sensitive issue is unproved.
He is injured in the V14 rescue and the V15 armor test, the armor fails against Orsted as a whole device, and courage in danger is not limitless empathy or omnicompetence.
The V15 diary's replica and apology concern an alternative future self; they are neither his acquired history nor present speech, and the diary's future is not scored.

All twenty-four checks are retrospective fits with disclosed prior familiarity, not clean holdouts or numerical prediction scores; scene confidence is high and mechanism confidence moderate, and no domain is DOMAIN_READY.

The evidence index, shared state ledger, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses to which the model routes its observations are not curated on this subject, so its observation locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
Unfamiliar diplomacy, adult family life, leisure beyond craft and solitary reflection outside represented passages are not established; this is a gap, not evidence of incapacity.
Nothing before V06 or after V15 is in evidence, V07 supplies context only and V12 supplies no state; later states, knowledge and outcomes are not assessed.
No humorous or playful instance is located, so humor and play are not assessed; this is a gap, not evidence that he lacks humor.
No romantic relationship of his is represented, so romance is not assessed; this is a gap, not evidence of disinterest or incapacity.
